# Sofia B.: synthetic edge-case patient

**Synthetic. No real patient.** Generated by `python -m kcd.fixtures.make_sofia` (deterministic; edit the
generator, not these files). Used by `python -m kcd.scenarios.edge_cases`.

57, clear-cell renal cell carcinoma with a VHL variant, chronic kidney disease stage 3, hypertension,
on sunitinib (a TKI) and amlodipine.

| File | What it is | Edge case it exercises |
|---|---|---|
| `ct-01-normal` … `ct-04-tumor` | CT key images (drawn here; the tumor slice is the demo's public one) | normal, cyst, stone, tumor signals |
| `ct-05-uncertain` | CT the model is unsure about (30/26/22/22 %) | out of distribution: kept out of the case pack |
| `ct-06-small-low-contrast` | 96 px, almost no contrast | quality "limited" (image too small, no contrast) |
| `ct-07-colour-screenshot` | colour screenshot instead of a CT slice | quality "limited" (not grayscale) |
| `ct-08-corrupt` | a truncated upload | unreadable: nothing sent, error recorded |
| `ct-09-model-down` | a normal study while the model service is down | model error: nothing sent, error recorded |
| `ct-10-other-model-version` | model updated but calibration not refitted | calibration stale: Safety Verifier rejects |
| `ct-11-mr-not-ct` | an MR study | not read (the Imaging Reader reads CT only) |
| `ct-scripted-outputs.json` | what the scripted CT model answers for each study | makes every run identical |
| `panel-2026.json` | current DNA panel: VHL pathogenic, FH likely pathogenic (ClinVar spelling), APOL1 homozygous, TP53 pathogenic, PBRM1 VUS, MET "conflicting interpretations", BAP1 benign | every variant class |
| `panel-2023.vcf` | older VCF panel | the most recent panel is used |
| `inbox/misfiled-panel.json` | another patient's panel, newer date | wrong-patient panel is blocked |
| `fhir-bundle.json` | record: conditions, medicines, eGFR series (latest 2026-05-01) | stale kidney result (165 days on 2026-10-12) |
| `lab-photo-ok.json` | lab photo after OCR: eGFR 49 | fresh data completes the conflict check |
| `lab-photo-ocr-error.json` | OCR misread 49 as 400 | Safety Verifier blocks the implausible value |
